<view class="{{rootClass}} py-4" data-disabled="{{disabled}}" bindtouchmove="handleTouchMove">
  <view class="{{trackClass}}">
    <view class="{{rangeClass}}" style="width: {{left}}%"></view>
  </view>
  <view class="{{thumbClass}}" style="margin-left: {{left}}%; transform: translateX(-50%)"></view>
</view>
